author: SR_Vlado
body:
IGN: SR_Vlado
Discord( Name#): SR_Vlado#8949
Timezone: UTC +2 (Summer time) UTC +1 (Winter time)
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I want to join the referee team because I really want to help the Avicus community to grow and participate in more tournaments. There aren’t so much staff in the server and I will really like to join the team to help in the developing and monitoring of new tournaments. Avicus is a server that have competitive gamemodes and maps with a very big potential to be played in tournaments.
Best time of the week?: The best time of the week for me are weekends and festive days. I am very active these days. I can’t use the computer on weekdays.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself (Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): I am a cheerful, friendly and confident guy. I take things very seriously when I have to. I am very patience when doing things and I am very calm in difficult situations. I have to admit that I sometimes talk a lot and it can sometimes get annoying, but that usually happen when I am playing, not refereeing. I think I can hold the position. I am very mature and I am not a toxic person.
Anything else?: I have been a staff member of Badlion for 1 year and one month, so I am experienced in terms of being staff in a server. I live in Spain, so I also speak Spanish and can help players that speak this language too.

Thanks for reading my application!
